author: xkcd's What If?
description:
Get a copy of What If? 2 and Randall’s other books at: https://xkcd.com/books
More serious answers to absurd questions at: https://what-if.xkcd.com/

This question comes from Jack, who asks: what would happen if I dug straight down, at a speed of 1 foot per second? What would kill me first?

Today’s topic is the reverse of the video which asked how you'd die if you rose steadily at a foot per second. Digging at the same rate would kill you more quickly.
